title: M2 epic: Evidence Bundle emission — --json on 6 gates + emit-evidence subcommand + v0.3.0 release
description: Milestone 2 of the build journey per ~/.claude/plans/se-the-council-bubbly-frog.md. Branch: feat/m2-evidence-bundle-emission. Adds --json to escape-scan, harness-hash, bias-count, gherkin-lint (arch-check + crap-score already have JSON). Adds emit-evidence subcommand wrapping JSON gate output in in-toto Statement v1 with predicate URI evals.intentsolutions.io/gate-result/v1 per intent-eval-lab/specs/evidence-bundle/v0.1.0-draft/SPEC.md. SemVer commitment doc. Backward-compat regression tests. CHANGELOG. v0.3.0 release. Note: cosign signing + Rekor push requires DNSSEC+CAA on intentsolutions.io (separate gate iel-4zr) — emit-evidence supports --no-sign for unsigned envelope until DNSSEC lands.
acceptance_criteria: audit-harness escape-scan --json emits valid gate-result JSON; same for harness-hash, bias-count, gherkin-lint; emit-evidence wraps JSON to in-toto Statement v1 validatable against intent-eval-lab JSON Schema; backward-compat tests confirm v0.2.0 text mode unchanged + exit codes preserved + stderr/stdout separation; SEMVER.md commits to additive minor; v0.3.0 in package.json + CHANGELOG; PR opened on feat branch awaiting Gemini review
close_reason: M2 epic complete. v0.3.0 in package.json + CHANGELOG. SEMVER.md commits to additive-minor + URI immutability. End-to-end pipeline: <gate> --json | audit-harness emit-evidence produces an in-toto Statement v1 whose predicate validates against intent-eval-lab gate-result.schema.json. Subject naming + digest invariants hold (subject.name == predicate.gate_id; subject.digest.sha256 == predicate.input_hash). cosign signing path supported but actual Rekor push gated on bead iel-4zr (DNSSEC + CAA on intentsolutions.io). PR forthcoming on feat/m2-evidence-bundle-emission.
